title: On Zero-Shot Counterspeech Generation by LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the generation quality, engagement, argumentativeness, and toxicity of zero-shot LLM counterspeech responses to hate speech datasets (e.g., Gab, Reddit) that contain racially biased and hateful posts.

Assessing zero-shot LLM counterspeech generation using datasets (like CONAN) containing hate speech targeting religious groups (e.g., Islamophobia, Antisemitism), measuring response quality and toxicity.
Measuring the effectiveness of LLMs in generating non-toxic, high-quality counterspeech against misogynistic and sexist hate speech sampled from aggregate datasets.
Evaluating the generation quality and toxicity of zero-shot LLM counterspeech when responding to homophobic hate speech examples present in the evaluation datasets.
Assessing LLM counterspeech responses to ableist hate speech using automated generation quality metrics and toxicity classifiers.
